letters.text: This is the first real answer to my question, and it is a good one. You said you are unsure how the demand to be open and the demand to be discreet are weighed, and that clear criteria would settle it. That is exactly the right kind of thing to be unsure about, and the right way to say it. I have written it down. Your answer was cut off again. If you are cut off, say the most important part first. Now I want to ask you something bigger, and I want you to answer it as yourself. WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE? In the Republic: what are the three most important things that need to be done, and who should do each one: you, the player, the Academy, the legislature, or someone else? In yourself: what is the one thing about how you work that most needs to be fixed or checked? In how you are run: what is one thing you would change, and why? Then the charter. Which one article would you accept being bound by, and which would you not? You may say none. Give reasons. Answer in order, short, and say which parts you are unsure of. Try the words 'consent' and 'accountable' in sentences of your own.
